name: Mythos Gates: Ascension Progression System
designPillar: Mythic Ascension: The player climbs through divine trials and fractured realms toward greater power.

progressionStages.description: The deity awakens through the first Mythos Gate, gaining base power and combat identity.
The deity proves worth through divine trials in each realm, mastering combat and mythic power.
progressionStages.rewards: Ability upgrades, relic unlocks, ascension materials

progressionStages.description: The deity faces mythic convergence — multiple realm threats merging through the Gates.
The deity achieves full ascension, unlocking ultimate power and the final gate threshold.
progressionStages.rewards: Full ascension form, ultimate divine skill, endgame content access

modifiers.name: Enemy Regeneration
modifiers.effect: Enemies recover at round end unless controlled.

modifiers.name: Reduced Healing
modifiers.effect: Healing effects are reduced, forcing prevention and positioning.

modifiers.name: Environmental Damage
modifiers.effect: Hazard tiles pulse every second round.

modifiers.name: Cooldown Pressure
modifiers.effect: Key abilities enter battle with +1 cooldown.

modifiers.name: Faction Restriction
modifiers.effect: At least three deities from a rotating faction required.

modifiers.name: Boss Mutation
modifiers.effect: Boss adds a new phase mechanic instead of simple stat inflation.

avatar_system.description: Players control Avatars (divine projections of Deities) projected through the Mythos Gates

belief.description: Spiritual fuel earned from victories, followers, and realm control
belief.use: Avatar level-ups and base stat increases
belief.source: Victories, followers, realm control, daily challenges

influence.description: Territorial power earned from missions, battles, and domain expansion
influence.use: Ability unlocks and upgrades, relic enhancement, Ascension tier unlocks
influence.source: Missions, battles, territory control, rival Avatar defeats

death_mechanics.penalty: 10-20% loss of unspent Belief and Influence
death_mechanics.preserved: Avatar level, abilities, relics, all progression

avatar_system.scale_rule: Option A — Avatars remain god-scale in all Realms. Power differences shown through aura intensity, ability charges, and cooldowns, not physical size.
